name: Water tap each day (count glasses of water on Today)

title: Backlog says "Steps and water each day" is live, but only steps exist
what: The backlog marks "Steps and water each day" as Live. The app shows today's steps from Health Connect. No water tap was found anywhere in the member app; the same backlog row admits the water tap is not built.
expected: The Live row names only what is built (steps), and water stays a separate pending item.
fix_line: Rename the Live row to steps only and list the water tap as pending

title: Backlog says Google Drive backup and automatic Drive backup are live, but both were stopped
what: The backlog marks "Google Drive backup and restore" and "Automatic workout backup" as Live, with a "Back up to Google Drive" row in Settings. Since 4 Nov the app no longer backs up to Google Drive: the upload code is still there but no screen calls it, and a phone with Drive linked is told that backups now go to the MettleUp account. Only bringing back an old Drive backup remains.
expected: The backlog says backups go to the MettleUp account and that Drive is restore-only, so no public text is written from the old rows.
fix_line: Rewrite the two backlog rows: backup is the MettleUp account, Drive is restore-only

title: Backlog says trainers' charts keep long-time members' history is live, but the server part is not switched on
what: The backlog marks "Trainers' charts keep the long-time members' history" as Live and released. The phone part is in the app, but it needs a database change that is marked not live and waits for the owner's yes. Until then members who joined before 23 Oct still share workouts only from the update day, so their trainers' charts stay short.
expected: The row says Waiting for you until the database change is live, or the change is applied.
fix_line: Say yes to the database change, or mark the row Waiting for you

title: Backlog says phone-number sign-in is switched off, but it is switched on in the app code
what: The backlog says "Sign in with your phone number" is built behind a switch that is off, with a server change and a privacy line still waiting for the owner's yes. In the code the switch is on, with a note that the owner approved it on 15 Nov and that the server change and privacy line are live. The backlog row is out of date, so anyone reading it gets the wrong state.
expected: The backlog row says the switch is on from the next phone release and names the approval.
who: the owner and anyone planning from the backlog
fix_line: Update the backlog row to say the sign-in is on

title: Switched-off "Muscles ready today" and "Quick workout" screens are still in the app with no gate
what: The backlog says both were switched off on 5 Nov and only the code is kept. The card is gone from the Workout tab, but the two screens themselves have no check, unlike the Plus pages, which go straight back when Plus is off. A link to either screen may still open it (not driven, read in code only). The feature list also marks them live.
expected: A switched-off screen cannot be opened by any route, and the feature list marks it hidden.
who: members who open an old link
fix_line: Add the same go-back check the Plus pages use, and mark both hidden in the feature list

title: Notes say the admin app runs only its own scripts, but one outside script is allowed
what: The task list says the admin app "runs only its own scripts and talks only to the gym server". The security rule the admin app is served with also allows a Cloudflare analytics script and talks to Cloudflare's analytics address and to the app website.
expected: The note matches the rule, or the rule allows only what the note says.
fix_line: Correct the note, or drop the outside analytics script
